'''Chapter 1186''' is titled "One More Time".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page]] Request: "[[Loki]] secretly drawing a picture of [[Ida]] and Ida secretly enjoying it" by PN Sunadango.
==Short Summary==
<!-- Do not add until official English release -->
After revealing that [[Manmayer Gunko|Shuri]] was in fact descended from the [[World Noble]] bloodline and what transpired on the day that King [[Reuven]] died, [[Brook]] asks his [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] crewmates to free her from [[Ragnir]]'s ice before heading off somewhere. Meanwhile, [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] has finally regained his strength and joined [[Loki]] in the fight against [[Nerona Imu|Imu]].

==Long Summary==
[[Brook]] overcomes the shock from the sight in front of him and immediately runs to [[Reuven|Reuven's]] body demanding a medic to save him, unwilling to accept that he has perished in front of him as he hopelessly begs him to hold on until then. One of the individuals, who turned out to be [[Nerona Imu|Imu]] possessing [[Marcus Mars|Mars]], closes the door and admits this was an inconvenient time to be interrupted as [[Manmayer Gunko|Shuri]] tells Brook that Reuven is gone. Brook gets up and draws his sword at the other individual, demanding to know who he is and what he has done to Shuri, as he wholeheartedly believes she would be incapable of such an action due to knowing her from the day she was born. However, Shuri then tells Brook something that according herself she just found out now: that she herself is the child of a [[World Noble]], and that Reuven was not her biological father.

Brook refuses to accept this and calls her Reuven's rightful heir, but Shuri states there is no proof she is his, and because of that she feels she has wasted sixteen years of her life living in ignorance of her heritage. In addition, Shuri reveals to Brook that Reuven lied about the slaves the World Nobles wanted; they really wanted her, and as such Shuri condemns Reuven for letting his people die for only one person, and the reason why she killed him to end this fight for good, even though this will mean [[Esperia Kingdom|Esperia]] will become a lawless wasteland. The other individual, who is revealed to be a [[Knights of God|Knight of God]] named [[Manmayer Gurou]], speaks up and says he remembers Brook as [[Candelle|Candelle's]] squire, and when Brook sees Gurou's eyes, he sees they are mismatched like Shuri's, revealing him to be her biological father, which causes Brook to fall back in shock. Gurou states he normally would not come all this way to pick up a child, but according to him bipolar irises are extremely rare and valued by Imu. He also begins to say that he himself was unable to awaken something, but perhaps Shuri can, though Imu silences him before he can say any more.

Gurou tells Shuri to make it quick and she approaches him with her sword, all the while Brook begs tearfully that this is not who she truly is. Shuri shuts him up stating she owes him nothing and that she no longer needs him, before driving her sword through his head and leaving with Gurou. Fortunately, Brook survived as the sword completely missed his major arteries and brainstem, so the damage was relatively minimal. Brook, however, asks his men, who found him, where Reuven is, and though they were hesitant to tell him, he insisted in knowing the truth, to which they solemnly tell him that they lost and Reuven is dead. They also tell him that they saw Shuri leave on a government ship and that several citizens have fled the country, but the image of Reuven's death and Shuri's betrayal left him devastated. 

His story finished, Brook tells his [[Straw Hat Pirates|crew]] that back then he did not know [[Devil Fruit|Devil Fruits]] existed, and he was so horrified by what he saw that day he made himself believe it was a hallucination from the shock of it all, but after seeing their own allies be transformed into demons, he has begun to reconsider his memories of that day. As such, Brook asks his crew if it would be okay to put his faith in Gunko being a victim in everything and if they can help him save her. Without hesitation, everyone agrees to help him and start brainstorming ways to free Gunko from the ice, but Brook just takes off before them all.

Back with [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] at the Walrus School, he has finished his feast and regaining his strength and takes off to rejoin the fight with [[Loki]], who is still struggling against Imu. Loki calls out Imu that he is fighting dirty by taking children hostage, but Imu reveals to Loki that 800 years ago, the giants once lost a battle by saving children, and this is precisely why he chose to target them. Loki is confused by Imu's words as he continues, explaining that the nature of a race can not change no matter how much time passes, and once he has all the children in his grasp, he will be able to control the giants as he so pleases. Loki demands to know what Imu is talking about, but Luffy suddenly arrives and punches Imu square in the face demanding he get out of [[Elbaph]].
==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Nerona Imu|Imu]], possessing [[Marcus Mars]], was present in [[Esperia Kingdom]]'s throne room. 
*[[Manmayer Gurou]] is a [[Knights of God|Knight of God]] and [[Manmayer Gunko|Shuri]]'s biological father.
**Shuri has the family's [[Manmayer Family#Family Trait|Bipolar Irises]], which might awaken a specific ability that Imu desires.
*Shuri stabbed Brook through the head. This attack would end up leaving a permanent scar on his skull.
*Brook asks for the [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]]' help in freeing Gunko.
*[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] joins Loki in the fight against [[Nerona Imu]].
*The [[giants]] lost the fight [[Void Century|800 years ago]] trying to save their children.

==Trivia==
* Throughout the start of this chapter, Reuven does not have the wings nor the horns he was depicted with in the [[Chapter 1185|previous chapter]].
* Brook's break down upon learning of Reuven's death mirrors his reaction upon hearing of [[Laboon]]'s surviving from [[Chapter 486]].
*Luffy punching Imu mirrors him punching [[Rosward Charlos]] in [[Chapter 502]], which was also mirrored by [[Donquixote Mjosgard]] hitting Charlos in [[Chapter 907]].
